messages:
elaine (AE): FYI — Aurora wants a short POC next week. They want to test a partner model called hydra-3b-quant (chat + embeddings). Need quick answers on compatibility, security controls, and a ballpark for dedicated pricing. Can we triage?
marc (sales-eng): Great, thanks. POC scope: chat latency target ~ <200ms p50, embedding throughput ~ 20 qps, expected concurrent sessions ~ 30. Timeline: 2-week POC. Main blockers are (1) whether hydra variant runs in our runtime, (2) whether we can host in a Dedicated sandbox with VPC, (3) cost estimate.
priya (ML eng): Quick Qs — do we have the model artifact URL? format matters (gguf/pt/onnx). Also need tokenizer files + vocab. Hydra-3b-quant implies quantized weights; important to know quant spec (nf4, q8, etc.).
dan (runtime-eng): We don't have hydra-3b-quant in catalog yet. If the model uses standard causal transformer & compatible tokenizer, it should be runnable but we need to validate KV cache offsets and layernorm ordering. Can you share the artifact? Meanwhile, two quick checks we can run locally:
```
# run compatibility smoke test
python tools/check_model.py --model-path ./hydra-3b --format gguf --expect-vec-dim 4096
```
This will verify tokenizer + embedding dim + basic forward pass. If it fails, share the model config.json.
priya (ML eng): Note on quant: if it's QAT-style 4-bit (custom scaling) vs static nf4, behavior differs. Our runtime supports static 4-bit (nf4) and int8 pathways; custom QAT variants may require a conversion step. Also recommend a tiny eval set (10 prompts) to sanity-check output drift after quantization.
tomas (prod-security): Security POV — for any Dedicated POC we need: (a) confirmation there will be no PHI in test data, (b) network design (VPC peering or Private deployment), (c) KMS key usage for model artifacts if vendor requires. Also please fill the security questionnaire ID #A-2026 when you have a chance. For initial sandbox we can approve limited egress rules.
elaine (AE): I'll ask Aurora to provide a sanitized 50-example eval set (no PHI). They can host artifact at a presigned S3 link: https://s3.partner/hydra-3b-quant-v1.tar.gz. They also need SSO + SCIM for their Ops team — is that doable for the POC?
marc (sales-eng): SSO via SAML is standard for Dedicated POCs — we can enable short-lived accounts. Pricing: can we get a quick estimate for 2-week Dedicated sandbox + expected per-token runtime costs?
dan (runtime-eng): Rough back-of-envelope: for a 3B-class model on a single A10x or equivalent GPU: Dedicated sandbox (2 weeks) — $7k-$10k (GPU infra + infra ops). Runtime token cost: ~ $0.0006/token for 4-bit optimized path; int8 a bit higher. If we can run nf4 static quant, we should hit the lower bound. Redwood Optimize will likely recommend kernel/quant combos to shave ~30-40% off token cost. Exact numbers after we run smoke tests.
priya (ML eng): Proposed plan: (1) smoke compatibility test within 48h once artifact is uploaded, (2) parallel security checklist + SAML enablement, (3) provision Dedicated sandbox and run the 50-example eval to collect latency/cost metrics, (4) decide on conversion (if needed) to nf4 or int8. Can owners be: dan (runtime) + priya (ML) + tomas (security) + marc (sales-eng)?
elaine (AE): Owners confirmed. I'll upload the presigned link to the questionnaire and schedule kickoff for Monday. Aurora agrees to sanitized data only and SAML for a 2-week window.
poc-bot: Ticket created: INF-4872 (POC: Aurora — hydra-3b-quant). Assigned: dan, priya, tomas. ETA: smoke test 48h.
marc (sales-eng): I'll draft the pricing note and share a short SOW for the 2-week sandbox once we have the smoke-test results. Thanks all — let's aim for measurable perf numbers before the week ends. :thumbsup:
